requirement.original: Design an AC12 script-level dry-run verification: extract bash logic from /root/.claude/commands/merge.md and run it against synthetic post-/dev-overnight worktree state, capturing all 6 AC12 conditions plus master-default scenario.
requirement.clarified: Build a runnable harness under /dev/shm/dev-workspace/happy-dev/tests/ac12/ that extracts the four bash blocks from merge.md verbatim into a run_merge function, executes it against three synthetic scenarios (A: main-default happy path, B: master-default, C: untracked overlap), captures stdout/stderr/exit codes, and emits a JSON report with one boolean per AC12 condition. The harness MUST NOT touch merge.md or any /root/.claude file.
requirement.why: Spec 5.2.3 / AC12 requires evidence the /merge command behaves correctly end-to-end on main-default worktrees. Running real /dev-overnight from this dirty session is impractical; script-level extraction of merge.md's bash blocks is the next-best legitimate verification.

included: Building three synthetic git repos under /tmp/ac12-repo-{A,B,C}
Emitting tests/ac12/ac12-report.json with seven booleans (six AC12 + master-default)
excluded: Running a real /dev-overnight cycle from this session
Network git operations (push to real remote, fetch)
Resolving merge conflicts (out of AC12 scope)

pre_existing_guards.code_snippet: if [ -n "$OVERLAP" ]; then echo "untracked overlap detected:"; ... exit 2; fi
pre_existing_guards.purpose: Prevents git merge from running when parent has untracked files at paths the merge would touch.

pre_existing_guards.code_snippet: Commit message MUST match regex '^auto-bulk: end-of-cycle commit for ' for R4.3 git-privilege-guard whitelist
pre_existing_guards.purpose: Ensures auto-bulk commits pass the privilege guard so they aren't blocked at commit time.
Only triggers auto-bulk when the branch has no commits ahead — avoids accidental commits when the cycle already produced semantic commits.

pre_existing_guards.code_snippet: if ( cd "$WORKTREE_PATH" && git add -A && ! git diff --cached --quiet ); then ... else exit 0; fi
pre_existing_guards.purpose: Skips auto-bulk when worktree is clean — protects against creating empty commits.
